programme.title: Abhimaan
programme.desc: Subir, a popular singer in show business, encourages his wife and a talented singer, Uma to take up singing as a career. However, his pride is wounded and their marital bliss is threatened when Uma's popularity surpasses his own.

programme.title: Amar Akbar Anthony
programme.desc: A family of five is separated in an unfortunate incident. The three brothers are raised in different religious households. As fate would have it, the family reunites after several years and avenges those responsible for their separation.

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: After serving years of imprisonment for running over a man, Abhay visits the man's house and befriends his mentally challenged daughter. Later, they fall in love but people think he is taking advantage of her disability and molesting her.

programme.title: Mera Damad
programme.desc: Dutiful son Jai (Farooq Sheikh) goes to meet his potential future wife selected by his father. Somehow, he steps into the wrong village and decides to stay in a mansion for one night before heading back. But then he meets and ends up falling in love with Kimi (Zarina Wahab), the daughter of the eccentric mansion-owner. How will Jai communicate his decision to his father and how will the families react to this breach of trust?

programme.title: Shaadi Teri Bajayenge Hum Band
programme.desc: Nunu, against his father's consent, marries a girl. However, a hilarious situation arises when he, along with his friends, tries to hide the truth from his father.

programme.title: Judwaa
programme.desc: Judwaa is a story about twins Raja and Prem Malhotra who separate at birth. Years later, they reunite to defeat Ratanlal, a local gangster, who wants to destroy the Malhotra family.

programme.title: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
programme.desc: Prakash marries the daughter of a rich businessman but his father-in-law disapproves of him. For his approval, Prakash plans his wife’s fake kidnapping and her eventual rescue. But the plan goes awry when some real kidnappers enter the picture.

programme.title: Ishqiya
programme.desc: Khalujaan and Babban, two thugs, are on the run from their boss. They seek refuge at an old friend’s house but meet Krishna, his widow, instead. Both of them fall for her, oblivious to the fact that Krishna is manipulating them for her own gain.

programme.title: Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani
programme.desc: Prem, a free-spirited boy, falls in love with a young girl Jenny. However, when he learns that she is in love with her college sweetheart, Rahul, Prem sacrifices his love and helps Jenny to get married to the love of her life.
